name: Facet
text: Choose a **full-width, single-column layout** with a **fixed-height top bar** for alerts and a **collapsible left sidebar** for navigation. This maximizes screen space for the graph—the core of EXCAVA—while keeping controls accessible without clutter. Trade-off: users lose vertical space for the graph when the sidebar is open, but the sidebar collapses to a thin strip on hover, preserving liveliness. The fixed top bar ensures critical alerts are always visible, meeting the need for speed and clarity.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A fixed-height top bar blocks the graph’s top edge when users scroll, hiding critical data—users won’t know what they’re missing. A sticky top strip risks the same, but at least it’s always visible. Settle it: test both with real data; measure how often users miss the top 10% of the graph.
